conditions.desktop: Apple M4 Pro, headed bundled full Chromium, 1280x900, roughly 120 Hz; timing excluded concurrent host tests/builds.
conditions.phone: Pixel 7a Chrome, 411x789, roughly 60 Hz; physical rendering, charging throughout. Entry gates at <=31 C and status zero (first Canvas pair used the stricter <=30 C). Per-case before/after readings retained; end status can rise.
conditions.hostConcurrency: Phone cases sometimes overlap host browser validation or the Mac benchmark. Runtime simulation/rendering runs on the phone; development serving remains a possible startup confound.
conditions.workload: Fresh same-seed world/arrival per zoom, faster fill, actual noclip movement, 20 seconds except the labelled 60-second sprint, 3-second warm samples, 30-second catch-up gate.
conditions.exclusions: Interrupted temperature-gate attempts, the contended first Mac baseline, discarded Canvas prototypes and the ineffective HTML-image-only cache pilot are excluded.
conditions.limits: Not a rerun of all 80 matrix cases. Thermal gates control entry only; rAF misses are not hardware presentation counters. Actor time/routes can differ. The matched uncached control disables only the cache branch at Vite transform time; it does not modify production files.
